mapper.insert: INSERT INTO venue (kopis_venue_id, name, address, district, latitude, longitude, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{venue.kopisVenueId}, #{venue.name}, #{venue.address}, #{venue.district}, #{venue.latitude}, #{venue.longitude}, #{now}, #{now}) AS n ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE name = n.name, address = n.address, district = n.district, latitude = n.latitude, longitude = n.longitude, updated_at = n.updated_at
